name: Call of Water
summary: Along Silverpine Forest's coast, shamans can renew their communion with water through Call of Water. Tiev Mordune offers another Water Sapta to those whose spirit-sight fades before they speak with the purified water spirit.

sections.title: A Helping Hand in the Mist
sections.body: Shamans drink a Water Sapta to see spirits near the elemental shrines. If its magic fades before they speak with the Minor Manifestation of Water, they can no longer enter the spirit realm to finish the trial. On Silverpine Forest's fog-shrouded shore, fellow shaman Tiev Mordune helps those whose visions end too soon.

sections.title: Renewing the Ritual
sections.body: Tiev Mordune has already defeated the corrupt water spirit off the coast and waits with the ritual remnants he gathered. To show you are ready, bring a fresh Water Sapta from Islen Waterseer in the Barrens. Tiev casts his gathered bracers and droplets into the shrine's brazier, summoning the pure manifestation again so you can speak with it and seal your bond with the element.

faq.answer: Tiev Mordune is a fellow Horde shaman on the coast of Silverpine Forest. He has defeated the corrupt water spirit there and stays by the shore to help shamans whose spirit-sight fades before they finish their communion.

faq.q: Why do I need a Water Sapta for this quest?
faq.answer: A Water Sapta lets your mind cross into the spirit world. Tiev needs a fresh draught from Islen Waterseer so you can see the elemental when he summons it again.

faq.q: What happens if I missed speaking to the water spirit?
faq.answer: If the Water Sapta fades or the Minor Manifestation of Water vanishes before you speak with it, you cannot finish the trial alone. Tiev Mordune rekindles the brazier with the trophies he gathered, so you can commune with the spirit.

faq.q: Where does this ritual take place?
faq.answer: The trial takes place on Silverpine Forest's western coast, by an elemental shrine facing the Great Sea.

faq.q: Who sent shamans on this pilgrimage?
aliases: who gave the call of water
faq.answer: Islen Waterseer, a tauren shaman, guides initiates through their Call of Water trials and brews the needed saptas. She lives by a fishing hut on the Barrens' eastern coast.

faq.q: What is the Minor Manifestation of Water?
faq.answer: The Minor Manifestation of Water is a purified elemental spirit summoned at the shrine after the corruption in the local waters has been cleansed. Communing with it completes this part of a shaman's elemental trials.

angles.text: As a shaman, you walk a hard path toward earning your Water Totem. This rite shows how shamans help one another so no initiate is left behind when a trance fades.
As a member of the Horde, you follow shamanic traditions of mutual aid and respect for natural spirits, even in Lordaeron's haunted lands.
